messages.subject: ctmm shinyapps io / ctmmweb Error Code 404
parts:
Greetings, I'm new to ctmm, and successfully used to the ctmmweb shiny app to run preliminary analyses with my data stored on MoveBank, about 6 weeks ago in March. But as of mid-April, I am no longer able to access ctmmweb; I get an error code 404 (page not found). This has persisted, on my Mac (with Safari & Firefox), and Windows PC (Firefox). Is the site down and if so, will it become available again anytime soon? If this is a me-only problem, do you have any suggestions?

Thanks in advance for any help you can provide,
JP

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: ctmm shinyapps io / ctmmweb Error Code 404
parts:
Hi JP & Nathan,

You should be able to run ctmmweb locally, if you follow the installation instructions: https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmmwebdoc/

If you need/want to run something hosted, then I recommend the ctmm MoveApps: https://www.moveapps.org/

The MoveApps are what we are supporting and actively developing from here on. ctmmweb will be maintained, but it will not be getting any new features nor cloud hosted.

Best,
Chris
